description: A non-human identity (client credentials) for pipelines, maintenance and collectors.

spec.description:
A non-human identity for jobs, maintenance and collectors (decisions D20 and D21, internal note
`design/scheduled-jobs.md`). With the platform identity provider the operator creates a client
with a service account and the audiences below and writes its credentials to the Secret
`sp-<name>`; with an external provider it only checks the Secret named in `existingSecretRef`.
The owner group's members may name the principal as a pipeline's `runAs`; nobody may read the Secret.

audiences.description: What the principal's tokens are valid for; at least one, `trino` by default.

items.description: What a principal's tokens are valid for (the `aud` claim of its access token).

existingSecretRef.description: Only with an external identity provider: the Secret that holds the app registration's credentials.

ownerGroup.description: The group whose members may use the principal. Members never read its credentials.

purpose.description:
What a service principal is for. It decides nothing by itself (grants do); it makes the intent
visible in `kubectl get` and in Nova.

ready.description: True when the client exists (or the referenced Secret is valid) and the Secret is written.

title: ServicePrincipal
